name: How much does AEO for Accountants cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does AEO for Accountants cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of AEO for Accountants varies based on several factors, including the scope of services, the size and complexity of your existing online presence, and the competitiveness of your local market. A customized strategy is developed after an initial consultation and audit, which then informs the pricing structure. Factors such as content creation, technical optimizations, and ongoing management all contribute to the overall investment. Most firms offer tiered packages or custom quotes to align with different budgetary and strategic needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO costs vary based on service scope, online presence complexity, and market competitiveness; custom quotes are provided after an initial audit.
